name: drone-delivery-thesis
description: Master's thesis product: a Gojek/Grab-style full-stack app for autonomous drone package delivery, with a web Ground Control Station (GCS).
author: Muhammad Rizky Permana

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,customer,gcs -c green,cyan,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:customer" "npm:dev:gcs"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @drone/api && npm run build --workspace @drone/customer && npm run build --workspace @drone/gcs
scripts.preview:pages: npm run build:pages && npx --yes serve site -l 8080
